facts.fact: Liberia's report to the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement database says that under the World Bank-funded LIFT-P, led by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, a National Single Window is being built through UNCTAD's ASYCUDA Programme, with the current phase integrating three government agencies and ASYCUDA to be upgraded.

note: The same report says full operationalisation remains to be done and the 2028 extension is shown as not approved, so no single window in service is stated.
